summary: Central PlayerProfile system unit for canonical shared truth, planner-only helpers, external-model state, and compatibility import quarantine.

provenance.policy: Embed centralized player-state data directly while preserving the committed contract or code source that defined each slice.
provenance.transientProbePolicy: Player-state currently does not depend on transient probe reports; future extracted imports should record their regeneration commands before being embedded.

requirementsBeforeArchive: The PlayerProfile boundary should eventually have a dedicated data-side contract projection instead of living primarily in code and docs.
Canonical, planner-only, external-model, and compatibility import lanes must remain explicit inside the centralized player-state unit.
Any future embedded imported-system slice must carry either a committed source file link or the exact regeneration command used to produce the transient extraction report.
